relationships.subject: Dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Dex significantly inhibited CCI induced neuropathic pain through targeting α2AR and HMGB1

relationships.subject: Dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Dex inhibited the inflammatory response through decreasing the release and the mRNA expression of IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-ɑ while increasing that of IL-10

relationships.subject: Dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Dex participates in the regulation of HMGB1, Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), NFκb (p-65) expression and the phosphorylation of IκB-ɑ

key_findings: Dexmedetomidine relieves CCI-induced trigeminal neuropathic pain via alpha2AR and HMGB1
Dex reduces IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha and raises IL-10, modulating HMGB1/TLR4/NF-kB
